summary: The development launcher now grants read access to the app-owned downloads directory, and the added test proves valid releases are served while missing releases stay unavailable.

evidence: scripts/dev.ts line 287 adds .data/downloads to the child server read grant while retaining public access.
scripts/dev_test.ts lines 52-55 assert the child server has exactly public and .data/downloads read access.
scripts/dev_test.ts lines 73-138 run the development arguments and verify metadata plus ZIP bytes for a staged release, then verify 404 downloads_unavailable for a missing release.
